# Accepted CodeQL findings

CodeQL findings are fixed in code. A real false positive may be dismissed through the API with the reason
"false positive" (or "used in tests" / "won't fix" where that is the honest label) and a justification comment, **and**
it is recorded here: rule, location, reason, date and alert number. Switching a rule off globally (`query-filters`)
is not allowed. Why: a click in the GitHub UI is invisible in the repository and cannot be reviewed.

Locations are `file:line` at the time of dismissal; code has moved and some identifiers were renamed since (for
for example test files and helpers were renamed to English). One row per alert; the table is checked by `tests/test_repo.py`.
